queue.title: The Boomerang Hire
queue.description: On rehiring people who already left once, and the honest work of figuring out whether the reason they left is still true.

queue.title: The Counteroffer Trap
queue.description: Why matching an offer after someone resigns almost never fixes the real problem, and what I learned the hard way at Beverage USA Holdings.

queue.title: What a Free Sample Really Costs
queue.description: We treat sampling as a marketing expense. It works better as a research instrument, and it can do real damage when it is aimed at the wrong person.

queue.title: The Interview Nobody Prepares For
queue.description: Most candidates rehearse answers to questions they expect. The moment that decides a hire is usually the one nobody saw coming, and it says more than the rehearsed parts.
